description: (Pomona, CA) – Michelle Rodriguez’s campaign announced today that the California Professional Firefighters have endorsed her candidacy for the 53rd Assembly District. The 53rd District includes the cities of Pomona, Chino, Ontario, Upland, and Montclair. View press release

title: CALIFORNIA PROFESSIONAL FIREFIGHTERS ENDORSE MICHELLE RODRIGUEZ FOR ASSEMBLY DISTRICT 53 - Michelle for Assembly
